prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 4x4 animated VFX sprite atlas, 16 sequential frames, for a fantasy RPG special skill named Carnival Break. No characters and no weapons. The effect is a weighty studded-club strike expressed as crimson-red and electric-cyan curved energy, sharp diamond-shaped sparks, and a brief violet shock ring with small rocky debris.
Use one coherent animation in reading order, left to right, top to bottom:
Frames 1-4: small interlocking red/cyan wisps gather at the center and twist into a compact charged knot.
Frames 5-8: the knot releases into a fast crescent swing traveling left to right, a red outer stroke and cyan inner stroke, evolving curved silhouettes with open negative space.
Frame 9: compressed contact flash at center, small bright core.
Frame 10: strong asymmetric impact burst, crisp red/cyan diamond shards and a ground shock arc, only a small white accent core.
Frames 11-12: expanding violet-edged ring and tumbling stone fragments, clearer transparent gaps between shards.
Frames 13-16: sparks fragment, thin out and fade into a few scattered colored motes, final frame nearly empty but not completely blank.
Painted high-quality 2D game effects, luminous but not opaque fog, no full-screen white explosion, no copied identical frames. Every frame must have visibly changing shape and distinct particles. Consistent centered emission origin and side-view orientation. Each effect occupies only the middle 65% of its cell and has at least 17% completely transparent padding to all four cell boundaries. Exactly four equal columns and four equal rows in a square image. True RGBA transparent background with alpha zero between cells. No floor/background plate, no characters, no club, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no border, no checkerboard.
reference: Approved V-980 Harley SD palette and club concept; no reference image required for effects.
